sights.address: North end of International Drive, Orlando, FL
sights.w: Orlando's largest midway-style park (15 acres) at the top of I-Drive per Frommer's, with the Freedom Flyer suspended family coaster; Orlando Informer recommends it as the lower-key, cheaper alternative to the big parks.
sights.k: roller coaster coaster ride family go-karts

sights.address: Alexander Springs Recreation Area, Ocala National Forest, Altoona, FL
sights.w: A 72°F first-magnitude spring in the Ocala National Forest about an hour north of Orlando, ideal for swimming, snorkeling and scuba year-round, per Florida Guidebook; on Orlando Weekly's springs-near-Orlando round-up.
sights.k: spring springs swim snorkel nature forest
